senses.gloss: ch. same, to be affected, disordered, smitten, punished.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 5:14">Targ. O. Ex. V, 14</cite> <he>לְקוֹ</he> (Y. <he>לָקוּ</he>). Ib. 16 <cite ref="L00696"><he>לָקָן</he></cite> (Y. <he>לָקְיָין</he>). Ib. IX, 31, sq.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 26:11">Targ. Y. I Num. XXVI, 11</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Temurah 4b:33">Tem. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>אמאי לָקֵי</he> why should he be punished?—
<cite ref="Temurah 5a:4">Ib. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>הא נמי לִילְקֵי</he> let him, too, be punished.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:10">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אין מטת מִילְקֵי וכ׳</he> if it should happen to thee to suffer, it is better that I suffer in thy place; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 23:1">Pesik. R. s. 23—24</cite> <he>חילמי</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 5:6">Targ. I Sam. V, 6</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 113b:4">Sabb. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דמַלְקֵי</he> because it is ruinous to health.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:5">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>מַלְקֵי ומכריז</he> punished the woman of bad repute and published the cause (for the protection of her children, v. <cite ref="L00604"><he>לַעַז</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מר נמי לַלְקֵי וכ׳</he> why do you not likewise punish and publish?; a. fr.
